title: Geometric regularity over a separable algebraic extension
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be a separable algebraic field extension and let $R$ be a $k'$-algebra. Then $R$ is geometrically regular over $k$ if and only if it is geometrically regular over $k'$; geometric regularity is the notion in [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
